_note: Reviewed skills allowlist. Copy is fixed; the model never writes advice. Reviewed against the team's content checklist: no diagnosis names, no treatment or outcome claims, one small action, under 5 minutes. This is not a clinical review.

skills.title: Prioritize
steps: Write every task you're juggling on one list.
Circle the one with the nearest deadline or the biggest cost if it slips.
Write the very first 10-minute step for that one task — only that one.

skills.title: Ten-minute start
skills.summary: Make starting smaller than the task.
steps: Open the task and do the smallest visible piece — a heading, one line, one question.
When the timer ends, you may stop. If you keep going, that's a bonus.

skills.title: Paced breathing
skills.summary: Slow your breathing for one minute.
steps: Breathe in through your nose for a count of 4.
Hold for 4, then breathe out slowly for a count of 6.
Repeat six times, then notice one thing you can see around you.

skills.title: Reach out to one person
skills.summary: One small message to someone you trust.
steps: Think of one person you'd be okay hearing from — a friend, sibling, classmate.
Send a short message. It can be as simple as "hey, free to talk later?"
You don't have to explain everything. Reaching out is the whole step.

skills.title: Wind down
steps: Pick a stop time for screens tonight and set an alarm for it.
Write down anything still on your mind so it's out of your head and on paper.
Dim the lights and do something low-effort until you feel sleepy.

skills.title: Nothing to fix today
skills.summary: Sounds like today is okay. That's a fine check-in.
steps: Still will check in again at your next scheduled time.
